title: Make the malformed-identity-after-shutdown test reach SourceId::validate
outcome: The shutdown regression for malformed observation identities includes a case that passes the early shape checks and fails only inside SourceId::validate, so a regression that accepted or relabelled a malformed identity under a cleared or cancelled capture scope would be caught.
acceptance: capture_shutdown_regressions::a_malformed_observation_identity_stays_malformed_after_host_shutdown (or a sibling test) adds at least one identity that reaches SourceId::validate and fails there, for example a tree that is not 40 lowercase hex, an invalid change status or unordered submodules, for both a sighting and a source-change baseline, with and without a stopped capture, and asserts the malformed refusal.
